claim: Of the 17 gateway sites the vendor-house census of 2026-10-08 found UNSCOPED against ADR 0221 (p4-scratch/f006/vendor-house-census.md, at origin/main 87dafc064), PR-1 fix/inbound-mail-vendor-house fixes the inbound bridge path behind two (census E #17 Gmail push, E #44 inbound-email webhook; behavioural proof apps/api-gateway/src/common/orchestrator/rabbitmq-bridge.vendor-house.spec.ts). The other 15 are still unfenced: D #1-2 documents intake and D #3 deliveries store a body providerId with no assertProviderBelongsToRestaurant; E #18 force-fetch has no @Roles; E #20-22 non-production test routes read or act by id with no house filter; F #7 site-sweep status returns the process-wide lastRun; G #14 the invoice-confirmed producer reads restaurant_id.is.null vendors; G #18-23 the unmounted contacts routes lack house filters. The verify exits 0 as soon as ANY ONE of them is fenced or removed (static reading per site, scripts/vendor_house_census_open.py), so the PR that fences one must restate this row, dropping that site here and in the script, or the build fails.
